# Index test: method versus model zero point

**Verdict: changing the method is sufficient to produce the missing ~0.2 dex.**
With the same Ceridwen grid, the clean sample moves from +0.097 to +0.345 dex (median paired change +0.203).
A separate model zero point can remain, but it cannot explain this change within one grid.

Medians compare the same galaxies. Delta is the median individual index-minus-full-fit difference, not the difference of medians.

| Inference | 49 usable pairs: [alpha/Fe] | Paired delta | 18 without masked pixels: [alpha/Fe] | Paired delta |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Full-spectrum posterior | +0.094 | — | +0.097 | — |
| Two indices, fitted SFH and iron history | +0.380 | +0.254 | +0.345 | +0.203 |
| SSP, 6.5 Gyr, free total metallicity | +0.410 | +0.321 | +0.400 | +0.308 |
| SSP, 3.5 Gyr, free total metallicity | +0.380 | +0.300 | +0.370 | +0.277 |
| SSP, free age and metallicity, adding H-beta | +0.390 | +0.294 | +0.380 | +0.254 |
| Mgb/Fe4383 ratio, fitted SFH and iron history | +0.330 | +0.227 | +0.330 | +0.222 |

The conditional two-index estimate rises in 44/49 galaxies and 17/18 clean galaxies. The clean paired shift has a galaxy-bootstrap 95% interval of +0.156 to +0.327 dex. At full-fit alpha rounded to 0.01 dex, clean spectra have median Mgb excess +0.829 A (+4.35 statistical sigma), but Fe4383 excess only +0.064 A. Changing only alpha reduces median two-index chi-square from 24.48 to 0.81.

## Measurements

All 60 entries in the supplied coverage list were inspected. Nine lack usable Mgb coverage, and two further spectra lack usable Fe4383 coverage. Both indices are measurable for 49 galaxies. The clean control has no masked pixels between either index's outer continuum edges. Missing indices are not extrapolated or filled with a model.

| Observed index | Measurable / 60 | Median EW (A) | Median statistical error (A) |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Mgb | 51 | 3.246 | 0.221 |
| Fe4383 | 57 | 3.595 | 0.331 |
| Fe5270 | 37 | 2.020 | 0.274 |
| Fe5335 | 31 | 1.945 | 0.250 |
| H-beta | 60 | 1.897 | 0.154 |

Bevacqua uses **MILES/BaSTI with a Chabrier IMF**, rather than TMJ. Its adopted method fits Mgb and Fe4383 together, with free metallicity and fixed SSP age 6.5 Gyr. It reports medians from 10,000 Gaussian realizations. It fits neither a Balmer index nor a ratio alone. The 3.5 Gyr arm is its age check. [Bevacqua et al. 2023, sections 4.1–4.2, equation 4, pp. 5–7](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2308.03441).

## Interpretation

This isolates a method effect, without separating continuum shape from other spectral pixels. Conditional scans respect the refused grid corner. Eighteen of 49 estimates reach their allowed upper bound, including five clean galaxies. The index result exceeds Bevacqua's +0.24 mean, so it does not calibrate the remaining model zero point. These are DR2 inputs, while Bevacqua uses DR3. [Bevacqua 2023, sections 2 and 4.2, pp. 2 and 7](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2308.03441).

No local Bevacqua catalogue was found. The publisher's supplementary-data link and public CDN returned HTTP 403. The candidate CDS catalogue path returned 404. No matched per-galaxy comparison is claimed.

<summary>Implementation, numerical checks and measurements for all 60 inputs</summary>

## Implementation and controls

- Feature windows match `ceridwen/observation/absorption_features.py`. Continuum windows follow [Trager et al. 1998, sections 2.1–2.2, equations 1–2 and Table 2, pp. 5–6 and 37](https://arxiv.org/pdf/astro-ph/9712258). Stored vacuum wavelengths become rest-frame air wavelengths. EW = integral(1 − F_lambda/C_lambda), with a straight pseudocontinuum. SciPy interpolates and integrates through exact band edges.
- Observed errors use 2,000 flux realizations, seeded 20261013 plus the selected coverage-table row. Masked pixels are omitted and interpolated between surviving data. Their systematic uncertainty is excluded, hence the clean control. Inference uses 10,000 index-error realizations, seed 20261013.
- The conditional arm fixes the joint maximum-likelihood SFH, iron history, dust and dispersion. Alpha steps are 0.01 dex. SSP arms use the paper's six metallicities, ten subdivisions per interval, and linear index interpolation between alpha = 0 and +0.4, extrapolated to −0.2/+0.6. The grid's `f_alpha` converts total metallicity to iron abundance before spectrum interpolation. [Ceridwen grid convention, d7c0536](https://github.com/potatoist314/ceridwen/blob/d7c0536/ceridwen/ssps/grid_metadata.py).
- Models match stored R_FWHM = 2500 and fitted stellar dispersion, subtracting the library variance through Ceridwen's `Spectrum` projector. Observations retain their existing broadening. Repeating Bevacqua's 150/200/250 km/s dispersion bins changes SSP alpha by a median 0.000 dex. [Bevacqua 2023, sections 2 and 4.1, pp. 2 and 5](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2308.03441).
- The grid refuses [Fe/H] > +0.25 with alpha > +0.4. Accordingly, 37/49 conditional scans stop at +0.4. Eighteen estimates reach their allowed upper bound, including five clean galaxies. SSP arms avoid that cell. Using native alpha planes instead of the paper's linear-index scheme gives SSP medians +0.420/+0.405 for all/clean galaxies. [Refusal contract, `refused_cells_logzsol` and `_check_refused_cells_theta`, d7c0536](https://github.com/potatoist314/ceridwen/blob/d7c0536/ceridwen/csp/csp_afe.py).
- The additional SSP-equivalent-age arm fits Mgb, Fe4383 and H-beta. Age spans 1–8 Gyr in 0.25 Gyr steps, limited by the stored cosmology's universe age. [Z/H] spans −1.00 to +0.35 in 0.05 dex steps. Native-alpha index predictions are interpolated to 0.01 dex. Median best-fit age is 4.25 Gyr and [Z/H] is 0.00. H-beta is not emission-corrected, so this is an age-sensitivity check.

## Provenance and numerical checks

Inputs: the supplied `coverage.csv`, `results/dr2-refit-2026-10-12/dr2-refit-summary.csv`, and each corresponding `run/fits/fit/<target>/ceridwen_result.h5`. Project base: `6b093a0f0b5906e64ea8d63e0d916f98d1b5f381`. Ceridwen: `d7c0536f9b2c5b8fad7fe4b1031dc75bb181ac97`. Grid: `~/.ceridwen/grids/amist_c3k_hr_krou_afe_nebular.h5`, content hash `chash-v1:46cb4109c265247008a790c71ec35266f9868818c3b6009a1b2c6ececfa57dc5`.

Local CPU only. No new Ceridwen fits or paid steps. Flat spectra give zero EW. All 60 noiseless index mocks recover injected alpha = +0.20 exactly. For M1_210210, cropping to 4250–5500 A reproduces the full-grid spectrum bitwise. Independent `specutils` integration differs by at most 0.00175 A across the five indices. Flux scaling by 17 changes EW by at most 5.4e−15 A. These checks validate the numerical calculation, not the absolute abundance scale.



EW and errors use rest-frame air A. Abundances use dex and sigma uses km/s. Blank values lack usable passbands. The clean flag excludes any masked pixel across both index spans. CSP percentiles describe index-error realizations conditional on the stored population. Full-fit values are stored posterior medians.
